title: Source-of-truth inventory
summary: The sphere is a documented continuity and qualification aid; source ZIP hashes point to exact 2026 packages. A ZIP or GitHub submission is not automatically an accepted, deployed service.
invariants: Always distinguish a consumer-facing scene plan from the underlying authoritative business record.
procedure: Review `README.md` and exact source package before changing any behavioural contract.
For Storage Fabric, Migratable Job, Node Allocation, Intention Service or Connect Selector inspect their currently accepted interfaces before binding new code.
